draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.95, the 152nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 5th of 11 at TE. He went 147th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (7th percentile), three-cone (0th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 3rd in receiving yards among the 10 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Houston Texans. 36 career games and 12 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2024 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (9th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 7 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
